author: Janelle Faignant Correspondent
title: Students showcase their art at annual Chaffee show | Local News | rutlandherald.com
text:
Paper origami hearts, pipe-cleaner daisies, a 3D forest scene with a grass floor, and an owl’s hypnotic gaze stared back at me from the floor of the Chaffee Art Center last weekend, where loose pieces and bins marked with masking tape identified the work of over 20 local schools participating in this year’s annual Student Exhibit, which opens Saturday with a reception from noon to 2 p.m.
Every year the walls of the mansion are splashed with original art from the young people in our area, and it’s a tradition that’s been going on for more than 40 years now.
